rows.v: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, broad market (SPY) sideways, fear elevated.
QQQ has lagged SPY by 4.4 points over 20 sessions. Tech is the weak spot; the broad market is holding up better.

Compared with the Nov 13 note: QQQ fell from 679.89 to 661.75 and is now 3.0% below its 200-day average, not just under it. SPY fell from 754.37 to 739.95 and is now 0.9% above its 1-month low of 733.00.

A QQQ close above 681.41, its 200-day average, would end the tech downtrend per the market gate and move the stance toward selective. A SPY close below 733.00 (1-month low), and especially below 729.58 (200-day average), would put the broad market's long-term trend down too and strengthen the case to stay aside.
